hero.title: Rahul Beniwal

hero.summary: Backend engineer with 4+ years of experience building scalable microservices and high-performance backend systems in Python. Proven experience designing REST APIs using Django and DRF, applying system design principles to deliver low-latency and reliable platforms. Experienced in integrating Agentic AI and LLM workflows using LangGraph, LangChain, and vector databases, and deploying production systems on AWS with Docker and CI/CD.

Built and maintained 20+ mission-critical integrations (Verizon, MoxiWorks, Regal, Century 21, Howard Hanna) using Celery and Redis, enabling large-scale data synchronization across platforms serving millions of users.
